name: No perfect ___ / reveal at the drop (GBX7 CapCut edit)
notes: Measured from the reference (30fps, 1080x1080): ~115 BPM. Before the drop: 4-beat shots (action / held push-in / held pan), a 0.43s flash shot, then a build shot that brightens ~1.8x. At the drop the build shot turns near-grey (sat 13) for one beat while the caption flips; then one shot per beat, muted (sat 37 vs 77 before), each pulling back 2-4%. Song has a sung vocal chop 5.8-8.7s (not dialogue) - keep it. Cut times are snapped to the song's beat grid - the reference's own picture cuts run ~0.15 s ahead of its audio (its video/audio are slightly out of sync), so copying them made our cuts early. Caption flip/grey beat sits on the strongest hit (8.243 s, the 'boom' before the drop) - user felt the flip on the full drop was too late; Barou shots start when the music opens up (8.815 s).
bars: bars start on beats k = 1, 5, 9 ... (0.575, 2.635, 4.695, 6.755, 8.815 ...): the song's phrase is one beat off a grid starting at 0.06
